slides.headline: October 29, 2018: India rolled out a train with no engine, built in just 18 months. It's now the country's fastest.
India's first engine-less, self-propelled train set rolled out of the Integral Coach Factory in Chennai
slides.body: Nicknamed "Train 18" for its 18-month build time, the Rs 100 crore prototype was designed and built domestically - a break from India's long reliance on imported rolling stock.

slides.headline: Renamed Vande Bharat Express in January 2019, it was commercially flagged off weeks later - and became India's fastest train.
slides.body: Built to replace the Shatabdi Express on key routes, it proved a domestically-engineered train could outperform the imported standard it was meant to succeed.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A Viksit Bharat builds the thing it used to import, and makes it the best version available.
slides.body: Train 18's 18-month build-to-rollout timeline became the template for a rail manufacturing program that's since multiplied Vande Bharat routes across the country.

sources.text: The Quint (PTI) - Train 18, Country's First Engine-less Train, Rolled Out
